## Purpose

Describe the problem and the proposed change.

## Evidence

List tests, benchmarks, traces, or references supporting the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover behavioural changes.
- [ ] Public interfaces and examples are documented.
- [ ] Security and privacy implications were considered.
- [ ] Research claims identify baselines, metrics, and limitations.
- [ ] The change does not record hidden chain-of-thought content.
- [ ] Backward-incompatible changes are called out explicitly.
